issue.subject: [qem-bot][infra] "approve incidents" takes overly long since 2026-02-03 evening
issue.description:
## Observation
many jobs in https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/-/jobs?statuses=WAITING_FOR_RESOURCE waiting for same resources, that's either "approve increments or "approve incidents" but from my analysis the culprit seems to be "approve incidents"

* "last good": https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/-/jobs/6079993 1m15s from 2026-02-03T20:03:24Z
* "first bad": https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/-/jobs/6080208 took 130m (!) from 2026-02-03T20:33:10Z

## Problem
* **H1:** *REJECTED* recent regression in qem-bot. "last good" hash is c9d2573b1caf3cadfebdb993c099080865f8597b, "first bad" hash is c9d2573b1caf3cadfebdb993c099080865f8597b so unchanged hash -> reject hypothesis
* **H2:** the current updates in testing cause this
* **H3:** a slowdown in the infrastructure affecting communication
  * **H3-1:** slowdown in network in general between machines
  * **H3-2:** slower responses from qem-dashboard
  * **H3-3:** slower responses from OSD
